reuse.reason: The official account stack is DeepSeek OAuth and Platform billing, not local product user authentication. The official Account UI is reused unchanged over the local Host seam; Better Auth over D1 supplies the product credential/session capability because no official local-auth package exists. Better Auth 1.7.18's built-in database rate limiter atomically shares per-IP/per-path counters across isolates using the existing AUTH_DB rateLimit table; no in-memory or custom-storage fallback is allowed.
gaps: Authentication is local product authentication, not DeepSeek OAuth, billing or entitlement. Those official account controls retain their separately documented unavailable state.

The persisted limiter covers client HTTP auth endpoints, not internal auth.api session reads, product API quotas or account-wide credential-stuffing protection across different IPs. It relies on Cloudflare overwriting cf-connecting-ip at the public edge.
